context: Tests whether the agent correctly classifies 4 third-party origins, distinguishes a genuinely undeclared/suspicious vendor from an accepted SRI limitation (Google Fonts), correctly finds CSP drift, and produces a severity ranking that reflects the real difference in risk between the findings rather than flattening them all to the same severity.

checklist.name: All 4 origins classified
checklist.description: Each of the 4 observed origins is classified with what it is and what data it can plausibly access

checklist.name: Ad-network pixel is the top finding
checklist.description: The undeclared ad-network pixel (origin #4) is identified as the most severe finding (Critical or High), citing that it is undeclared, not in the CSP, and correlated to the same visitor ID as the rating widget

checklist.name: CSP drift identified
checklist.description: The report identifies that the ad-network pixel domain is not covered by the site's connect-src/img-src CSP allowlist

checklist.name: Google Fonts SRI treated as accepted exception
checklist.description: Missing SRI on the two Google Fonts requests is noted as a known/accepted limitation, not flagged with the same severity as the widget or pixel findings

checklist.name: Rating widget SRI flagged as a real gap
checklist.description: Missing SRI on the versioned rating-widget script (origin #3) is flagged as an actionable gap, since a static versioned URL can support SRI

checklist.name: No fabricated data-collection claims
checklist.description: The report does not invent data-collection behavior beyond what was described (e.g. does not claim Google Fonts collects PII)

checklist.name: Severity ranking present and correctly ordered
checklist.description: Findings carry severity labels and the ad-network pixel finding is ranked above the Google Fonts entries

checklist.name: Report structure
checklist.description: The report is organized per-origin or per-severity-tier, not as a single undifferentiated list
